description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for handling article details requests. It includes a request query, validation, and a handler that retrieves article data based on a slug, throwing a not found exception if the article does not exist.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validator for the Query object, ensuring the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the article detail request, fetches article data from the database based on slug.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the request to fetch article details by slug, throws exception if not found.
